blocks.text: “Kapag friends, friends lang.” But what if that platonic feeling turns into something more serious—like getting butterflies in your stomach whenever you’re around each other? If you suddenly yearn for your friend’s presence? Or worse, or maybe not, what if all the ordinary things you do together suddenly become special? The first thought, of course: “Wala lang ’to.” Denial. Well, that familiar feeling has been turned into a catchy and playful love song by rising singer-songwriter Mariah Deborah. Her latest hit, ‘Na Para Bang,’ has become an anthem for people who started catching feelings for their friends. According to the singer, […]...
